confidence_semantics: publisher/source authority only; not parcel numeric accuracy

candidates.publisher: Environment Agency / Defra Data Services Platform
candidates.name: Survey Data Catalogue - finding available data in Area of Interest
verified_facts: EA directs AOI availability checks to its Survey Index Catalogues.
EA states that if no data is listed for the queried AOI, it has not surveyed that location to date.
semantic_limits: NO_DATA requires a real AOI/catalogue query; failure to retrieve a filtered response is not NO_DATA.

candidates.name: OS Terrain 5 Technical Specification
verified_facts: OS Terrain 5 grid uses regular 5m post spacing and is supplied in 5km by 5km tiles.
Grid and contour products are generated from the same source data; GML uses EPSG:27700.
semantic_limits: Multiple formats are correlated representations, not independent observations.
5m post spacing is resolution, not parcel-specific accuracy.

candidates.name: OS Terrain 5 source data
verified_facts: OS Terrain source DTM is captured as a TIN using mass points, breaklines and photogrammetric/automated techniques.
Grid and contour products are interpolated from the source TIN; source rules include geometric fidelity, terrain smoothness and positional accuracy requirements.
semantic_limits: TIN source-model quality does not create independent evidence from the derived Terrain 5 grid.

candidates.name: OS Terrain 5 grid data
verified_facts: The Terrain 5 GML grid file contains metadata and spatial reference information while the actual height values are supplied in the external ASCII grid block.
semantic_limits: GML metadata alone is not a numeric terrain observation.

candidates.name: OS Terrain 5 tile metadata
verified_facts: Terrain 5 supplies GEMINI XML metadata per tile, including tile reference, spatial representation and horizontal/vertical reference information.
semantic_limits: Metadata statistics and CRS fields are provenance/context, not an additional elevation sample.

candidates.name: OS Terrain 50 Technical Specification
verified_facts: Terrain 50 uses 50m grid posts and 10m contours and is supplied in 10km by 10km tiles.
Grid and contour forms derive from the same source data.
semantic_limits: Terrain 50 remains a coarse secondary cross-check and its formats are correlated.

candidates.name: OS Terrain 50 grid data
verified_facts: Terrain 50 ASCII grid height values are calculated at pixel centres in a 200 by 200 grid of 50m pixels for a 10km tile.
Height values are stored to the nearest 0.1m.
semantic_limits: Stored decimal precision is not measurement accuracy.
Pixel-centre sampling is too coarse to substitute for EA DTM1m parcel sampling.

candidates.name: OS Terrain 50 source data
verified_facts: Terrain 50 grid and contours are interpolated from a source TIN captured with mass points and breaklines in a photogrammetric environment.
semantic_limits: Grid/contour agreement is correlated because both derive from the same source TIN.

candidates.name: OS Terrain 50 data structure
verified_facts: Terrain 50 grid heights are pixel-centre raster values and spot heights are selected from an interpolated surface.
OS states spot heights cannot be guaranteed to be summits or the highest point of a feature.
semantic_limits: Spot-height labels must not be promoted to parcel extrema without independent finer-resolution evidence.

candidates.name: OS Terrain 50 tile metadata
verified_facts: Terrain 50 provides GEMINI metadata including 10km tile reference, spatial representation and coordinate reference information.
semantic_limits: Tile metadata is provenance/context and not a second terrain measurement.

candidates.name: HM Land Registry plans - title plan detailed guidance
verified_facts: The title plan supports the register by graphically identifying the general extent of registered land.
All title plans show general boundaries unless a boundary is shown as determined under section 60 of the Land Registration Act 2002.
The guidance was updated 13 July 2026.
semantic_limits: Measurements shown on title plans do not convert a general boundary into an exact boundary.

candidates.name: HM Land Registry plans - boundaries
verified_facts: The June 2026 guidance distinguishes physical, legal, general and determined boundary concepts and explains difficulty in showing precise legal-boundary positions on plans.
semantic_limits: General-boundary/title-plan context cannot be treated as survey-grade parcel geometry.

candidates.name: Boundary agreements and determined boundaries
verified_facts: A determined boundary is the route for recording the exact line of a registered-estate boundary after that line has been identified.
The guidance was updated 1 June 2026.
semantic_limits: Ordinary INSPIRE/index/title-plan geometry must not be promoted to determined-boundary status without explicit register evidence.
